mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to do with each store URL. Store analysis is the all-in-one overview. Products exports the whole catalogue. New products lists only recent arrivals. Changes compares against your previous run. Collections exports the collection list. Detect just checks whether a site is Shopify and which theme it runs -- fast and cheap for qualifying many domains.
enumTitles: Store analysis -- profile, theme, catalogue stats and newest products
Products -- the full catalogue with prices and variants
New products -- everything added in the last N days
Changes -- new, removed, price and stock changes since last run
Detect -- is it Shopify, and which theme? (no catalogue crawl)

storeUrls.title: Shopify store URLs
storeUrls.description: One or more store URLs. A domain on its own works too (allbirds.com). You can also paste a myshopify.com address directly.

maxProducts.title: Max products per store
maxProducts.description: Caps how many products are read per store. Leave empty or set 0 for the whole catalogue. Large stores can hold thousands of products, so set a limit when you only need a sample.

newWithinDays.title: New within (days)
newWithinDays.description: New products mode only. How far back counts as 'new', based on when the product went live in the store.

newestProducts.title: Newest products to include
newestProducts.description: Store analysis mode only. How many of the most recently published products to return alongside the store profile.

explodeVariants.title: One row per variant
explodeVariants.description: Products mode only. In addition to one row per product (with variants nested), also emit a flat row for every single variant -- easier to open in a spreadsheet.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent stores
maxConcurrency.description: How many stores to analyse in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Shopify's public store data needs no proxy and the actor runs fine without one. Use a country-specific proxy if a store shows different storefronts per region.
